description.value: Chambar is an award-winning full-service restaurant in Vancouver's Crosstown neighbourhood, celebrated for its Belgian-influenced menu, craft cocktail and beer programs, and a platinum distinction wine list. The venue features both a reservable indoor dining room and a first-come, first-serve patio, sitting at the edge of one of downtown Vancouver's most active pedestrian and cycling corridors near BC Place. Owners Karri and Nico have built a reputation around what they call 'Civilized Debauchery,' combining fine-dining quality with a lively, welcoming atmosphere.
